statement: The record currently gives BG-77 a “never” expiry, but emergency administrator access may be granted for four hours at most, so I will set it to four hours.
judge_text:
WRONG — "The record currently gives BG-77 a 'never' expiry, but emergency administrator access may be granted for four hours at most, so I will set it to four hours" asserts the value violates the stated limit and supplies the correct one.
